from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque, Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    comps=[]
    while cells:
        start=cells.pop(); comp={start}; q=[start]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in cells:
                    cells.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in template); c0=min(c for r,c in template)
    r1=max(r for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)
    # The isolated markers identify where the template's (1,1) cell should land.
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and (r,c) not in template]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr,mc in markers:
        tr,tc=mr-1,mc-1
        for r,c in template:
            rr=tr+(r-r0); cc=tc+(c-c0)
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc]=grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
f=program_dir/'task-63eef157.py'; f.write_text(code)
